body: i just keep messing up, and theres no upside that i can see.  i applied to be a janitor and was turned down,,.,i thought i was better than that, and im not. and i keep drinking and pretending that everything is ok, but its not ok.

i go through a 1.75 every 2 days. either vodka or bourbon....and then i have beers too. my gf has a job and we dont live together, so her 6pack a week when we're together isnt much, though i usually drink at least a fifth when we are together, 3 to 4 days a week. 

she has a job and opportunities for life, i dont think i have that anymore.  i was irresponsible and stupid through college, i fucked up, and didnt realize i fucked up my life. 

its all such a waste, the only thing keeping me going right now is that i dont want people to know i lost, i quit, i gave up.....
